title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function R(θ) $$=$$ $$\frac{1}{1000}$$ sum{i extbackslash=1}{3}{abs(x_i-θ)} is a measure of how far each data point is from θ. Think about what value of θ would make the sum of these distances as small as possible.

title: Exploring Absolute Values
text: The absolute value function, $$|x|$$, measures the distance of $$x$$ from zero. In this context, $$|x_i-\theta|$$ measures the distance of each ride count from θ. Consider how you can minimize these distances collectively.

title: Choosing the Right θ
text: Which value of θ minimizes the sum of absolute deviations from the data points {1, $$6$$, 17}?

title: Median as a Minimizer
text: In a set of numbers, the median is often the value that minimizes the sum of absolute deviations. Consider how this applies to the dataset {1, $$6$$, 17}.
